source.allowed_records: 12-hour GPS Point data and Herd column only

independent_geographic_reference.provider: Wyoming Game and Fish Department (WGFD) official designated corridor, hosted via ArcGIS FeatureServer
independent_geographic_reference.label: MuleDeerMigrationBaggsWGFDCorridor
independent_geographic_reference.reported_description: Northern Dad/Atlantic Rim 38 deer and 90 migration sequences; southern Wild Horse 80 deer and 208 migration sequences; 2005-2016 GPS, WGFD-edited corridor polygons
independent_geographic_reference.external_reference_snapshot: Web indexed public source; no claims to reidentification of exact independent animals or raw polygons

tests: For each eligible AtlanticRim Point: transform from each frozen input CRS to EPSG:3857, tally inside the fixed WGFD full extent (unbuffered); no point maps
Repeat with fixed 5000-meter buffer around rectangle on every side; do not adjust based on outcomes
Record number of AtlanticRim rows, finite transformed rows and aggregate inside counts; no individual-level export
Also report how many CRS candidates cannot be distinguished in the coarse check; do not pick one as true
claim_boundary: Public WGFD corridor is geographically cross-sourced but may share original animal data; not independent ecological replication
Spatial rectangle is a bounding envelope of corridor polygons, not the corridor itself: an inside fix is not proven corridor use
Herd Atlantic Rim vs Baggs/Dad spatial overlap is anticipated but not assumed complete; do not tune bounding box
Study/source records 2007-2019 vs official reference 2005-2016; historical coverage and collared animals may differ
Different datum variants EPSG5070 and EPSG5071 are not guaranteed distinguishable by geographic registration
Publisher .prj/README EPSG3742 discrepancy remains unresolved without documented author processing history
No dense 2-hour holdout, no model fit, no prospective EOG prediction, no EOG-WF re-scoring
